fields.name: Responses
fields.about: Each produce response.

fields.name: Name
fields.about: The topic name.

fields.name: TopicId
fields.about: The unique topic ID

fields.name: PartitionResponses
fields.about: Each partition that we produced to within the topic.

fields.name: Index
fields.about: The partition index.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: BaseOffset
fields.about: The base offset.

fields.name: LogAppendTimeMs
fields.about: The timestamp returned by broker after appending the messages. If CreateTime is used for the topic, the timestamp will be -1.  If LogAppendTime is used for the topic, the timestamp will be the broker local time when the messages are appended.

fields.name: LogStartOffset
fields.about: The log start offset.

fields.name: RecordErrors
fields.about: The batch indices of records that caused the batch to be dropped.

fields.name: BatchIndex
fields.about: The batch index of the record that caused the batch to be dropped.

fields.name: BatchIndexErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message of the record that caused the batch to be dropped.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The global error message summarizing the common root cause of the records that caused the batch to be dropped.

fields.name: CurrentLeader
fields.about: The leader broker that the producer should use for future requests.

fields.name: LeaderId
fields.about: The ID of the current leader or -1 if the leader is unknown.

fields.name: LeaderEpoch
fields.about: The latest known leader epoch.

fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: NodeEndpoints
fields.about: Endpoints for all current-leaders enumerated in PartitionProduceResponses, with errors NOT_LEADER_OR_FOLLOWER.

fields.name: NodeId
fields.about: The ID of the associated node.

fields.name: Host
fields.about: The node's hostname.

fields.name: Port
fields.about: The node's port.

fields.name: Rack
fields.about: The rack of the node, or null if it has not been assigned to a rack.
